subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — Olive Tech: party details, evidence & redline priorities
messages:
From: Jenna Swartz <jenna.swartz@olivetech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — Olive Tech

Hi Stephanie / Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached are our standard MSA and the Order Form (PDF). We're hoping to get a countersigned agreement in place quickly so we can onboard before the end of September. High-level asks from our side: 

- Data residency: we need confirmation that EU customer data will reside in the US region only for the initial rollout (we can discuss exceptions).
- SOC 2 / pen test evidence: procurement will request the latest reports.
- Billing / PO: who is the billing contact and what invoice cadence can Redwood support?
- Signature authority: confirm who at Redwood will sign (and whether DocuSign is acceptable).

Target timeline: we would like initial redline comments back by 2026-08-27 so our legal can review and respond by 2026-09-01. Is that workable?

Attachments: Olive_MSA_v1.docx (MS Word), OrderForm_Olive_2026.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate a quick read and an initial triage.

Best,
Jenna Swartz
Procurement Manager
Olive Tech
jenna.swartz@olivetech.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Swartz <jenna.swartz@olivetech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — Olive Tech

Hi Jenna — thanks, I have the docs and timeline. Quick triage from our side: 

- We'll route the MSA to Legal for clause redlines (liability, indemnity, IP, data processing).
- Kimberly (cc'd) will pull SOC 2 and recent pen test/attestation evidence and share a redacted package.
- On billing: please send the PO template/number and preferred invoicing cadence (monthly vs. net-30). Our billing contact is billing@redwood.com but I'll confirm the person.
- DocuSign is fine. Signatory: we typically have Director-level auth for this tier; I'll confirm exact name after intake.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal legal review complete 2026-08-26 (target)
2) Consolidated comments to you 2026-08-27
3) Negotiation window 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-01

If anything on your side changes (PO timing or data residency constraints), flag it quickly and we can adjust.

I'll loop in Legal and capture action owners.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: MSA + Order Form kickoff — Olive Tech (action items)

Marissa / Kimberly — forwarding intake from Olive Tech. Please own the bullets below: 

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Jenna Swartz <jenna.swartz@olivetech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — Olive Tech

(attachments: Olive_MSA_v1.docx; OrderForm_Olive_2026.pdf)

Action items for Redwood: 
- Marissa: primary on commercial/legal redlines. Focus areas: liability cap (propose $XMM or a multiple of fees), IP carveouts for customer data, and termination/transition obligations. Please prepare a short redline summary (high-level positions) by EOD 2026-08-25.
- Kimberly: pull SOC 2 Type II (latest), pen test summary (redacted), and the DPA template. Share links or a redacted bundle by 2026-08-25 so procurement can attach it to their vendor file.
- Stephanie: coordinate billing contact and confirm signatory authority; I'll own follow-up with Jenna on PO cadence and DocuSign.

Proposed internal timeline: legal review completed by 2026-08-26; consolidated comments out on 2026-08-27. If legal needs more time, flag and we'll adjust the negotiation window.

Notes: Jenna asked for EU residency note — they expect US-only region for now. If that becomes a hard requirement we may need to consult infra.

Thanks — please confirm ownership in-thread.

Best,
Stephanie

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jenna Swartz <jenna.swartz@olivetech.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 15:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — Olive Tech (redline plan)

Thanks for the heads-up, Stephanie. Confirming ownership:

- I'll own the MSA redlines and will prioritize the items below for initial push:
  * Liability cap (we'll propose a fees-based cap tied to a 12-month revenue multiple)
  * Indemnity reciprocity limited to third-party claims arising from Redwood services
  * Data Processing Addendum (attach DPA and flag cross-border processing clauses)
  * IP: carveouts for customer-provided models/data and a clear services license for Redwood's runtime
  * Termination assistance / export of customer data timeline (30 days by default)

- Deliverable: short redline summary and a tracked redline file (MS Word) by 2026-08-25 EOD. I'll put the draft in Drive and share link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_redlines

Kimberly — can you confirm whether the SOC 2 package should be redacted or if we can provide the full report under an NDA? Jenna, if you have a procurement portal or specific upload target we can use, let us know.

Jenna — quick asks for your intake team so our redline matches procurement expectations: 1) billing contact and PO number (if available), 2) preferred jurisdiction for contract (if Olive has a firm requirement), 3) any mandatory SLAs beyond standard Redwood SLOs.

Attachments: MSA_Redline_Summary.txt; ExhibitA-party-sheet.xlsx (party contacts & billing fields)

I'll start the redline draft this afternoon and flag high-impact asks for negotiation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
